Container.Name: Feynman
Container.Overview: Unofficial Unraid Docker packaging for Feynman, the open-source AI research agent by Advait Paliwal. Includes the browser-based Science Workbench for research projects, literature workflows, artifacts, notebooks and model-provider integrations.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: AI research papers science literature agent Feynman alphaXiv
Container.Requires: Internet access is required for hosted model providers and online research sources. By default the WebUI has no built-in authentication and should only be exposed on a trusted LAN or behind an authenticated reverse proxy.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Feynman Science Workbench.

Config.Name: Feynman Config
Config.Description: Persistent Feynman settings, sessions, credentials and Workbench state.

Config.Name: Workspace
Config.Description: Research workspace containing outputs, papers, notes and project files.

Config.Name: Workbench Port
Config.Description: Internal Workbench listen port. Normally keep this at 8787.

Config.Name: Disable Workbench Auth
Config.Description: true = convenient trusted-LAN access. false = Feynman generates a token URL on each container start; retrieve it from the container log.
